cv.name: Danielle Kowalczyk
cv.headline: Corporate Counsel – Healthcare Regulatory & Commercial Contracts
cv.summary: Attorney admitted in New York with five years of practice after an earlier career as an ICU nurse. Advises healthcare providers and digital health companies on HIPAA, provider agreements and regulatory investigations, drawing on clinical experience to work closely with medical teams.

experience.title: Corporate Counsel
bullets: Lead counsel for vendor, payer and physician services agreements across 14 outpatient sites
Advise clinical and IT leadership on HIPAA privacy and security questions, including breach assessments
Built a contract playbook and clause library in Ironclad; standard NDAs now close in two days instead of a week
Support Stark Law and Anti-Kickback reviews for new physician arrangements

experience.title: Associate
bullets: Drafted motions and discovery responses in medical malpractice defense matters
Reviewed clinical records and prepared expert witness outlines for 30+ depositions

experience.title: Registered Nurse – Medical ICU
bullets: Cared for critically ill adult patients in a 24-bed ICU; charge nurse on night shifts

education.details: Health Law Concentration; Moot Court Board

skills: HIPAA, HITECH, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute
certifications: Admitted to the New York State Bar, 2022
extra_sections: Volunteer, Legal Aid clinic for patients with medical debt
